effect_description_eng: [Start of Your Main Phase] By trashing 1 card with [Garurumon] in its name or the [VB] trait from your hand, ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.) and gain 1 memory.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] If your hand has 7 or fewer cards, ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.)
